offers_adventures.name: Collect Moonlight Bulbs
offers_adventures.description:
I search and search and search, but MOONLIGHT BULBS are so hard to find. I have a huge list of things to find today, would you mind helping me out?

Collect MOONLIGHT BULBS all over Trove to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.

offers_adventures.name: Mine Nitro-Glitterine
offers_adventures.description:
Master Pun-Chi says to go run we must first walk. Well I've been walking all over this desert and I'm no closer to done with his list. Could you please help me and collect NITRO-GLITTERINE?.
ITRO-GLITTERINE to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.

offers_adventures.name: Mine Shapestone Ore
offers_adventures.description:
Greetings Trovian. I have been tasked by my master with obtaining crafting materials for my training, but my master asks too much. There is not enough time, and what he asks for is difficult to find. If you wouldn't mind helping me I would be very grateful.

Mine SHAPESTONE Ore to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.

offers_adventures.name: Mine Primordial Flame
offers_adventures.description:
Tro... vian... it's so... hot. I'll never... find the ore... my master wants... please help.

Mine PRIMORDIAL FLAME to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.

offers_adventures.name: Mine Glacial Shards
offers_adventures.description:
H-H-Help m-m-me. T-T-Too c-c-cold t-t-to t-t-hink. M-M-Mine G-G-GLACIAL S-S-SHARDS p-p-please.

Mine GLACIAL SHARDS to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.

offers_adventures.name: Mine Infinium Ore
offers_adventures.description:
Trovian, please help! Master Pun-chi has tasked me with finding INFINIUM ORE, but it's impossible. Even if I were to find it there's many many other tasks as well. Please help, you're my only hope!

Mine INFINIUM ORE to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.

offers_adventures.name: Collect Plasma
offers_adventures.description:
Living in the Neon City means your life runs on PLASMA, and we go through a lot of it. It's an exhausting task, mind giving me a hand?

Use the PLASMA SPONGE to collect PLASMA to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.

offers_adventures.name: Collect Irradiant Powercells
offers_adventures.description:
Master sent me here to conquer my fear of heights. It's not working. Would you mind collecting IRRADIANT POWERCELLS for me so that I can get out of here. Why would anyone want to live so high up?

Collect IRRADIANT POWERCELLS to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.

offers_adventures.name: Mine Veridium
offers_adventures.description:
VERIDIUM. That's all I need to be done with this planet, but I can't find it. Maybe you will have better luck, mind helping me out?

Mine VERIDIUM to unlock trading it with the Overtasked Disciple in the Hub when he needs it.

Press [HK:Loot] to interact.

offers_adventures.name: Return the Pirate Hat
offers_adventures.description:
There's a waterproof note inside the brim:

''Property of Saltwater Sam. Please return to me in the Fishing Area of the Hub if found.''

Saltwater Sam would probably appreciate the favor.

offers_adventures.name: Remove Unsightly Weeds
offers_adventures.description:
UNSIGHTLY WEEDS, everywhere I look instead of glorious fae fauna I see weeds. This is unacceptable. When I screamed for the gardner I was informed that I had fired the gardener. Given that, I must find a replacement. You seem capable.

As regeant of all of the Fae that I can see I conscript you to pull every UNSIGHTLY WEED you can see.

Find and pull weeds from the ground in the CURSED VALE, FAE FOREST, JURASSIC JUNGLE, and FORBIDDEN SPIRES.

offers_adventures.name: Find Chillio's Body
offers_adventures.description:
Yo Trovian. As you can see I'm in a bit of trouble. Every so often the sun shines a bit too much and my head melts off my body. The worst part is my body doesn't seem to realize it. Could you do me a favor and find my body. The last time this happened I didn't get fixed till Snowfest!

Press [HK:Loot] to interact with Chillio's Body.

offers_adventures.name: Help Contain Bad Souls

offers_adventures.name: Mine Formicite Ore
offers_adventures.description: Formicite Ore is so tasty when paired with gumdrops, you need to try it! Formicite Ore Veins are blue in color and you can find them on or below the surface of Trove. Mine some up and you won't regret it.

offers_adventures.name: Collect Air Gem Boxes
offers_adventures.description: Collect Air Gem Boxes from Cursed Skylands. Air Gem Boxes can drop from dungeon bosses or world bosses.

offers_adventures.name: Clear a Cursed Skull Pile
offers_adventures.description: These lands are cursed and I can't be free until all the cursed skulls have been taken care of. Please, knock one of them out for me Trovian, I beg of you.

offers_adventures.name: Collect Bleached Bones
offers_adventures.description: Have you ever chewed on Bleached Bones? They are SUPER tasty! You should try them sometime! You can find them in Dragonfire Peaks and Cursed Vale.

offers_adventures.name: Catch Water Fish
offers_adventures.description: Catch some beautiful water fish for me, Trovian. Only real fish will count, I don't need another boot weighing me down!

offers_adventures.name: Collect Water Gem Boxes
offers_adventures.description: Collect Water Gem Boxes from Drowned Worlds. Water Gem Boxes can drop from dungeon bosses or world bosses.

offers_adventures.name: Gather Faerie Dust or Enchanted Wood
offers_adventures.description: Faerie Dust and Enchanted Wood can be found all over the Fae Forest and they unleash magic into the world when collected. Please, gather them up and let the magic flow!

offers_adventures.name: Find a Feather or Dragonscale
offers_adventures.description: Fiery Feathers and Blue Dragonscales are hidden all over these breathtaking Forbidden Spires. You may be able to scare one up by knocking out the guardians that patrol this place.

offers_adventures.name: Mine Shapestone Ore
offers_adventures.description: Shapestone ore, its everywhere in this desert! Shapestone ore veins are pink in color and you can find them on or below the surface of Trove. Mine some up, I'll make it worth your while.

offers_adventures.name: Complete 5-Star Dungeons
offers_adventures.description: There is much to be done, Trovian. The strongholds of the Shadows must be destroyed. Seek out 5-Star Dungeons on the surface of Geode and reduce them to ruins!

npcs.name: Igeneous Islands World Adventure - starting zone

offers_adventures.name: Collect Fire Gem Boxes
offers_adventures.description: Collect Fire Gem Boxes from Igneous Islands. Fire Gem Boxes can drop from dungeon bosses or world bosses.

offers_adventures.name: Catch Lava Fish
offers_adventures.description: Catch some heated lava fish for me, Trovian. Only real fish will count, I don't need another boot weighing me down!

offers_adventures.name: Fight a T-Rex, you coward
offers_adventures.description: You look like a coward, kill one of the T-Rex roaming around the Jurassic Jungle to prove me wrong.

offers_adventures.name: Defeat a Rampage Boss
offers_adventures.description: Protect Neon City and defeat a Rampage boss!

offers_adventures.name: Defeat Enemies in Luminopolis
offers_adventures.description: Defeat Enemies of the Resistors in the Luminopolis region of Neon City.

offers_adventures.name: Defeat Dungeon Bosses in Neon City
offers_adventures.description: Defeat 3 Dungeon Bosses in Neon City to keep the Resistors strong.

offers_adventures.name: Collect Plasmium in Neon City
offers_adventures.description: Collect 50 Plasmium from the robots in Neon City to utilize their power. (Cannot be acquired via Trading Post or the Marketplace)

offers_adventures.name: Mine Primordial Flame
offers_adventures.description: The Resistors need resources! Mine Primordial Flame for their cause. Primordial Flame is an orange and black ore that can be found in Neon City and the Dragonfire Peaks. Primordial Flame ore can also rarely be found within Shapestone, Formicite, and Infinium ore veins.

offers_adventures.name: Catch Jade Neon Darters in Neon City
offers_adventures.description: Jade Neon Darters can only be fished up in Plasma. Must be fished up in a Neon City biome to count.

offers_adventures.name: Complete Dungeons
offers_adventures.description: 1 Star, 3 Star, or even 5 Star dungeons, I don't care! I just want to see dungeons cleared of the evil that inhabits them.

offers_adventures.name: Make a Luminopolis Donation
offers_adventures.description: The Resistors have set up Donation Stations at the Adventure Outposts across Luminopolis. Please, Trovian, donate to one of the Luminopolis Donation Stations to show the Resistors we have your support.

sign.title: Outpost Merchant

offers_adventures.name: Gather Glacial Shards
offers_adventures.description: I can't stand to see so many Glacial Shards just waiting to be mined! Dig some up, please. Glacial Shards are a white and blue ore that can be found all over the Permafrost.

offers_adventures.name: Mine Geode Topside Ore
offers_adventures.description: The Sunseekers need you to be as strong as can be if you're going to stand with us against Undertow. Gather up Veridium and Nitro-Glitterine and you can use it to craft or enhance Crystal equipment.

offers_adventures.name: Defeat Enemies in Luminopolis
offers_adventures.description: Defeat enemies of the Resistors in the Luminopolis region of Neon City.

offers_adventures.description: Return the Chicken to its rightful location in the Tutorial world
